     2  ! Paper 4 (piezoelectric ring) -- first FE cross-check deck for the F-F

     5  ! Sec 18.149 (F-F derivation + validation) and the sibling scripts  
     6  ! probe_piezo_p4_ff_forward_model_2026-09-15.py /   
     7  ! probe_piezo_p4_elastic_ff_baseline_2026-09-15.py. 
     8  !   
     9  ! ============================================================  
    10  !   
    11  ! ============================================================  
    12  ! UNITS RESCALE (2026-09-16), following LESSONS_LEARNED.md Sec 18.161's 
    13  ! "next concrete step, not yet attempted": a from-scratch, validated,   
    14  ! consistent unit-system rescale of the whole piezo deck family, to 
    15  ! shrink the ~20-order-of-magnitude spread between the mechanical block 
    16  ! (order 1E9-1E13 in SI Pa-based units) and the electrical/piezoelectric
    17  ! block (permittivity order 1E-9 F/m) that five independent cheap-lever 
    18  ! probes (jobs 2490482, 2490571/2490582, 2490583) could not resolve.
    19  !   
    20  ! CHOSEN SYSTEM: mm - N - s - tonne (mechanical), REAL VOLTS (electrical
    21  ! potential unchanged). This is NOT an arbitrary or guessed choice -- it
    22  ! is the one non-SI system where the force unit N and the time unit s   
    23  ! are UNCHANGED from SI (since tonne*mm/s^2 = 1000kg*1e-3m/s^2 = kg*m/s^2   
    24  ! = N exactly), which is why frequencies (1/s) come out in real Hz with 
    25  ! zero further conversion, and it is the standard "mm-N-s-tonne" system 
    26  ! already ubiquitous in mm-scale FE work (ANSYS/LS-DYNA/Abaqus alike).  
    27  !   
    28  ! DERIVATION (first principles, cross-checked 3 independent ways -- T-  
    29  ! equation substitution, electromechanical energy-density bookkeeping,  
    30  ! and base-unit/derived-charge-unit substitution -- all three agree):   
    31  !   
    32  !  length      L' = L[m] * 1000                      (m -> mm)  
    33  !  mass        M' = M[kg] * 1e-3                      (kg -> tonne; 
    34  !                                                       DERIVED, not
    35  !                                                       independently   
    36  !                                                       chosen, from
    37  !                                                       F=ma consistency)   
    38  !  density     rho' = rho[kg/m^3] * 1e-12             (kg/m^3 -> tonne/mm^3)
    39  !  stress/     E' = E[Pa] * 1e-6                       (Pa -> MPa = N/mm^2; 
    40  !  modulus                                             an exact, always-
    41  !                                                       valid physical  
    42  !                                                       unit conversion)
    43  !  potential   V' = V[Volt]  (UNCHANGED -- our deliberate choice, so
    44  !                              VOLT dof / D,ALL,VOLT,0 BCs stay literal,
    45  !                              physical volts, no BC rewriting needed)  
    46  !  el. field   E_field'[V/mm] = E_field[V/m] * 1e-3   (implied by the   
    47  !                              geometry now being in mm; not a material 
    48  !                              constant, so nothing to type in directly)
    49  !  ABS.        eps' = eps[F/m]  UNCHANGED NUMERICALLY. Proof: F/m, fully
    50  !  PERMITTIVITY decomposed into base units, is F/m = (C^2/(N*m))/m =
    51  !  (MP,PERx)   C^2/(N*m^2); substituting the SI identity C = N*m/V (from
    52  !              V=J/C, J=N*m) gives C^2/(N*m^2) = N/V^2 -- the "m" cancels   
    53  !              EXACTLY, so absolute permittivity has NO net length  
    54  !              dependence once expressed in N and V (which are both 
    55  !              unchanged in this system) -- confirmed independently by  
    56  !              the energy-density route (T-form energy density (1/2)eps*
    57  !              E^2 must equal (1/2)eps'*E'^2 once both are expressed in 
    58  !              the new energy-density unit MPa=mJ/mm^3, and E'=E*1e-3   
    59  !              exactly cancels the implied 1e-6 from Pa->MPa against
    60  !              eps' = eps, i.e. no eps rescale needed). 
    61  !  PIEZO e-    e' = e[C/m^2] * 1e-3. Derived from the T-equation
    62  !  CONSTANT    T = c:S - e^T:E: converting T and c from Pa to MPa (each 
    63  !  (TB,PIEZ,   x1e-6) and E from V/m to V/mm (x1e-3, i.e. E=E'*1e3),
    64  !  TBDATA,     T'*1e6 = c'*1e6*S - e*(E'*1e3)  =>  T' = c'*S - (e*1e-3)*E'  
    65  !  stress form)  => e' = e*1e-3. Independently re-derived via the   
    66  !              charge-unit-substitution method (deriving the coherent   
    67  !              charge unit Q* implied by keeping real Volts and mJ=N*mm 
    68  !              energy, Q*=1e-3 C, then re-expressing C/m^2 in Q*/mm^2)  
    69  !              -- both methods agree exactly: e' = e[C/m^2] * 1e-3. 
    70  !  length      any PURE length tolerance (e.g. NUMMRG's node-merge  
    71  !  tolerance   distance) is rescaled x1000 like any other length, e.g.  
    72  !              1.0E-8 m -> 1.0E-5 mm.   
    73  !   
    74  ! NOT hand-derived from an "empirical" ABAQUS-forum factor (the risk the
    75  ! session notes flagged) -- every factor above follows from ANSYS's own 
    76  ! documented TB,PIEZ constitutive form (T=c:S-e^T:E, D=e:S+eps^S:E, 
    77  ! stress-form default TBOPT, already independently confirmed correct in 
    78  ! Sec 18.157) and ordinary SI dimensional analysis, not a borrowed number.  
    79  !   
    80  ! VALIDATION STAGING (per the ground rules -- do NOT trust a coupled
    81  ! result in the new units before these pass): this submission batches   
    82  ! the bare-host elastic-only deck and the piezo-coupling-off deck   
    83  ! rescaled into these SAME units FIRST. Both are purely mechanical  
    84  ! eigenvalue problems (piezo-coupling-off has e=0 everywhere, so its
    85  ! VOLT dof is present but completely decoupled from the mechanical  
    86  ! modes) -- their frequencies are mathematically GUARANTEED invariant   
    87  ! under any internally-consistent unit rescaling, so they are a real
    88  ! check on the ARITHMETIC of this conversion (did every E, rho, C_ij
    89  ! actually get rescaled correctly), not on the physics. Confirmation
    90  ! criteria: (a) rescaled bare-host mode 2 must reproduce 114.89 Hz  
    91  ! (job 2490363's own result) to at least 4 significant figures -- NOT   
    92  ! merely "close to 115.68 Hz", since a few-percent FE-discretization
    93  ! gap is expected and already characterized, but ANY unit-conversion
    94  ! arithmetic error would show up as a gap much larger than that 
    95  ! already-known discretization error, or as a wildly wrong number; (b)  
    96  ! rescaled piezo-coupling-off mode 2 must reproduce 118.81016 Hz (job   
    97  ! 2490456's own result) to at least 4 significant figures, same 
    98  ! reasoning. If EITHER fails, the units arithmetic (not the physics) is 
    99  ! wrong and the FIX-v6-coupled result below must not be trusted.
   100  !   
   101  ! ONLY once (a) and (b) both pass does the coupled result below become  
   102  ! trustworthy: mode 2 should land near 119.058 Hz (closed-form target)  
   103  ! with a real O(0.1-1)-magnitude bending discriminator and the exact 0 Hz   
   104  ! rigid-body mode should reappear, if the ~20-order-of-magnitude SI-units   
   105  ! disparity really was the root cause of the catastrophic ill-  
   106  ! conditioning (residual 4.15E+02 at full coupling, job 2490482).   
   107  ! ============================================================  
   108  ! WHY THIS DECK: no literature F-F piezo benchmark exists (LESSONS_LEARNED  
   109  ! Sec 18.144 Finding 2 -- confirmed again, not re-litigated here), so FE is 
   110  ! the ONLY external validation channel available for the F-F piezo-coupled  
   111  ! forward model, per PAPER4_PIEZO_ROADMAP.md Sec 8 step 3. This is the  
   112  ! layered-ring FE cross-check the C-C side never needed (C-C had Duan2005   
   113  ! Table 4 to check against directly) and the disk smoke deck
   114  ! (ansys_piezo_disk_modal_plane223.inp) was NOT (monolithic disk, different 
   115  ! geometry, no benchmark target either -- see that deck's own header).  
   116  !   
   117  ! TARGET TO CHECK AGAINST: probe_piezo_p4_ff_forward_model_2026-09-15.py's  
   118  ! own p=0, h1/2h=1/12 result: omega=747.9929 rad/s => f=119.058 Hz. This
   119  ! deck's job is to find a genuine FE flexural mode near that frequency, not 
   120  ! to blindly trust whichever mode number happens to fall near it -- see the 
   121  ! MODE-SHAPE DISCRIMINATOR note below, this matters because a layered   
   122  ! axisymmetric solid mesh mixes flexural (bending) and extensional  
   123  ! (breathing/radial) mode families in one spectrum, unlike the pure-
   124  ! bending Kirchhoff theory this project's own solver assumes.   
   125  !   
   126  ! GEOMETRY: layered annular ring, R_i=0.1 m, R_o=0.6 m (Duan2005 Table 4's  
   127  ! own target), steel host |z|<=h (h=0.01, Duan's own half-thickness 
   128  ! symbol), PZT4 piezo layers bonded symmetrically on both faces,
   129  ! h<=z<=h+h1 and mirror -h-h1<=z<=-h, h1=2h/12 (Table-4 ratio 1/12).
   130  ! TRUE FREE-FREE: since R_i=0.1 > 0, the ring does NOT touch the axis of
   131  ! revolution, so (unlike the disk smoke deck, which needed UX=0 at r=0 to   
   132  ! suppress the on-axis singularity) NO mechanical constraint is applied 
   133  ! anywhere -- this is a genuinely unconstrained modal solve. Expect rigid-  
   134  ! body translation (and, if p>0 were modeled, rotation) modes near f=0 Hz   
   135  ! at the bottom of the spectrum; these are correct, not a bug (same 
   136  ! precedent as the disk smoke deck's own mode-1-at-0-Hz note).  
   137  !   
   138  ! ELEMENT/MATERIAL STRATEGY: ONE element type (PLANE223, KEYOPT(1)=1001,
   139  ! KEYOPT(3)=1 axisymmetric) used for BOTH the steel host AND the PZT4   
   140  ! layers, with two different material IDs -- NOT two different element  
   141  ! types -- specifically so the host/piezo interface line shares nodes   
   142  ! naturally through ordinary area meshing (no manual node-merging step, 
   143  ! no mismatched-DOF-set interface to debug). The steel material gets the
   144  ! piezoelectric (TB,PIEZ) terms all zero and a small nominal permittivity   
   145  ! (not exactly zero -- an exactly-zero diagonal permittivity would leave
   146  ! VOLT undefined/singular at any node touching ONLY steel elements) so  
   147  ! every node in the mesh carries a well-posed VOLT dof, even though VOLT
   148  ! is physically meaningless in the steel region (e=0 there, so it never 
   149  ! couples to anything mechanical) -- this mirrors how coupled-field meshes  
   150  ! with an inert region are conventionally built, not a project-specific 
   151  ! trick.
   152  !   
   153  ! ELECTRICAL BC: DRIVEN 1 V (lever 9), not open-circuit and not 
   154  ! both-faces SC. VOLT=0 on the host/piezo INTERFACE (z=+-h). Outer  
   155  ! faces z=+-(h+h1) have D,VOLT,1.0 on every node (prescribed 1 V
   156  ! bus). Do not re-open mesh/units/TB,PIEZ.  
   157  !   
   158  ! MODE-SHAPE DISCRIMINATOR (read the postprocessing section before  
   159  ! trusting a specific mode number as "the" flexural mode): a genuine
   160  ! p=0 axisymmetric BENDING mode has UY (axial = out-of-plane transverse 
   161  ! displacement, matching this project's w) nearly the SAME SIGN AND 
   162  ! MAGNITUDE through the thickness at a given r (Kirchhoff kinematics:   
   163  ! uz=w(r), no z-dependence), while UX (radial, in-plane) has OPPOSITE   
   164  ! SIGN top vs bottom (bending strain ur=-z*dw/dr, linear in z, flips sign   
   165  ! through the mid-plane). A "breathing"/extensional mode is the reverse:
   166  ! UX same sign top/bottom (uniform radial stretch), UY small/near-zero. 
   167  ! The postprocessing block below prints UX and UY at matched top/bottom 
   168  ! node pairs at the outer radius for every extracted mode specifically so   
   169  ! this can be checked by eye against the printed table, rather than 
   170  ! trusting mode order alone.
   171  !

   182  ! discriminator signature -- DECISIVELY ruling out geometry/meshing/
   183  ! free-free-BC as the cause and narrowing the search to THIS deck's own 
   184  ! piezo coupled-field/permittivity setup. FIX v4 applied below: X_INERT 
   185  ! raised from 1.0E-15 to 1.0E-9 (same order of magnitude as the real

   187  ! itself and LESSONS_LEARNED.md Sec 18.154 for the full rationale and   
   188  ! pre-registered confirmation criteria. NOT YET RE-RUN. 
   189  !   
   190  ! STATUS UPDATE (2026-09-15, FIX v6, following the piezo-coupling-off   
   191  ! isolation deck's DECISIVE PASS, job 2490456 -- LESSONS_LEARNED.md Sec 
   192  ! 18.156): the elastic layered composite alone (TB,PIEZ,2 zeroed) lands 
   193  ! at 118.81 Hz, 0.21% from the 119.058 Hz target -- conclusively
   194  ! implicating THIS material's TB,PIEZ,2 TBDATA block as the sole
   195  ! remaining cause. A from-scratch re-derivation of ANSYS's TB,PIEZ  
   196  ! TBDATA convention (cross-checked against ANSYS's own coupled-field
   197  ! docs AND an independent forum-posted worked example for a Y-poled 
   198  ! material, both agreeing exactly) found the convention is: 18 values,  
   199  ! grouped by STRESS/STRAIN ROW (x,y,z,xy,yz,zx -- 6 groups of 3), each  
   200  ! group cycling the electric FIELD column (X,Y,Z) fastest -- i.e.   
   201  ! TBDATA index = (stress_row-1)*3 + field_col. This deck's PREVIOUS 
   202  ! block (and the disk-smoke deck's, ansys_piezo_disk_modal_plane223.inp,
   203  ! it was copied from) instead filled TBDATA as if grouped by FIELD row  
   204  ! (3 groups of 6, stress cycling fastest) -- the TRANSPOSE of ANSYS's   
   205  ! actual matrix, an easy mistake for TB,PIEZ specifically since (unlike 
   206  ! the symmetric TB,ANEL block, which this same deck gets right) the 
   207  ! piezoelectric matrix is a non-square 6x3 and the row/column meaning   
   208  ! is easy to invert. Read literally, the OLD block placed the response  
   209  ! of the HOOP normal stress (row 3) to the RADIAL field (E31, should be 
   210  ! exactly zero by transverse-isotropy symmetry) and to the POLING field 
   211  ! (E33=14.1 instead of the correct E31=4.1, ~3.4x too large) -- while   
   212  ! leaving ALL THREE of the physically dominant, active bending-relevant 
   213  ! terms exactly zero: radial-normal-stress<->poling-field (E31, row 1), 
   214  ! axial-normal-stress<->poling-field (E33, row 2), and the r-z bending  
   215  ! shear<->radial-field term (E15, row 4, the only piezo term that   
   216  ! directly couples to Kirchhoff-type bending shear). This fully accounts
   217  ! for a spurious, physically nonsensical dominant electromechanical term
   218  ! unrelated to true bending stiffness -- consistent with the observed   
   219  ! ~29x frequency / ~840x apparent-stiffness anomaly, far beyond real
   220  ! PZT4 coupling factors (k^2~0.3-0.7). FIX v6 (below): TB,PIEZ,2's  
   221  ! TBDATA rewritten to the verified-correct layout -- nonzero at 
   222  ! positions 2 (E31), 5 (E33), 8 (E31), 10 (E15); position 15 (E15) is   
   223  ! the second, symmetric shear term but is kinematically inert here (no  
   224  ! hoop displacement DOF in this axisymmetric, non-torsion element, same 
   225  ! as rows 5/6 already being inert per the Sec 18.156 manual audit). 
   226  ! PRE-REGISTERED CONFIRMATION CRITERIA for the next run: (a) mode 2 
   227  ! should land close to the 119.058 Hz closed-form target -- given the   
   228  ! coupling-off baseline is already 118.81 Hz (0.21% off), the genuine   
   229  ! coupling-induced shift should be small (a fraction of a percent, NOT  
   230  ! a jump to/near 3422 Hz); (b) the discriminator should show the same   
   231  ! clean bending signature as job 2490456 (UY_top~=UY_bot, UX_top~=-UX_bot)  
   232  ! at that mode, not the 1E-10-to-1E-17 noise floor seen in every prior

   304  ! Nominal inert permittivity for the steel region -- NOT physical, only 
   305  ! keeps VOLT well-posed there (see header). The steel material's own
   306  ! TB,PIEZ block is all-zero (e=0), so X_INERT's VALUE cannot mechanically   
   307  ! couple to anything regardless of scale -- only VOLT-dof conditioning is   
   308  ! affected. FIX v4 2026-09-15 (LESSONS_LEARNED Sec 18.154, following the
   309  ! bare-host isolation deck's DECISIVE clean result, job 2490363, which  
   310  ! ruled out geometry/meshing/free-free-BC entirely and narrowed the 
   311  ! search to this permittivity scale): raised from 1.0E-15 to 1.0E-9,
   312  ! the SAME ORDER OF MAGNITUDE as the real PZT4 values (X11=7.124E-9,
   313  ! X33=5.841E-9) instead of ~6-7 orders of magnitude below them. ANSYS's 
   314  ! own coupled-field modeling guidance for an inert region sharing a mesh
   315  ! with a real piezo material is that the inert permittivity should not  
   316  ! be many orders of magnitude smaller than the surrounding material,
   317  ! since that scale mismatch is a textbook cause of the Block-Lanczos
   318  ! ill-conditioning warning seen in job 2490350 ("relative residual from 
   319  ! test linear solve: 9.147498E-02"). NOT YET RE-RUN -- see Sec 18.154   
   320  ! for the full pre-registered confirmation criteria.
   321  X_INERT = 1.0           ! relative (host VOLT well-posed). Was 1.0E-9 fed as if absolute.

   325  ! EPSREL FIX (2026-09-16): PLANE223 MP,PERx is RELATIVE permittivity.

   327  ! eps_r * eps0). Parent UNITS_MM decks fed those F/m numbers to MP,PERX

   331  ! (8.85e-12 F/m); relative ~805 * EPZRO recovers the Duan absolute

   333  ! is numerically invariant under that rescale). Host X_INERT is now a

   335  ! in the mesh, TB,PIEZ FIX v6, units, or electrical BC is changed

   380  RECTNG,RI,RO,-H,H              ! area 1: steel host

   383      
   384  ! FIX v2 2026-09-15 (job 2490219 post-mortem -- v1 fix above was diagnosed  
   385  ! wrong): the TRUE bug is that LSEL,,LOC,... is a GLOBAL, area-UNSCOPED 
   386  ! select -- at X=RI/X=RO/Y=H etc, it matches every line at that coordinate  
   387  ! across ALL THREE stacked areas (their edges are coincident/touching by
   388  ! construction), not just the area currently being processed. Area 1's  
   389  ! block (run first) ends up setting NDIV=6 on ALL SIX vertical lines in 
   390  ! the model, including area 2/3's own -- so when area 2/3's blocks later
   391  ! try LESIZE,...,NDIV_ZP(=2) on their vertical edges, LESIZE's default  
   392  ! KFORCE=0 silently REFUSES to change an already-nonzero division ("
   393  ! PREVIOUS NONZERO VALUES WILL NOT BE ALTERED", confirmed in job 2490219's  
   394  ! own log) -- NDIV_ZP never actually takes effect on either piezo layer,
   395  ! both stay at NDIV=6. Combined with the (correctly working) NDIV_R=40  
   396  ! radial sizing, that's 40 x 6 = 240 elements/layer at aspect ratio 45 --   
   397  ! exactly what both job 2489625 and 2490219 produced, unchanged, because
   398  ! the v1 fix touched the radial dimension, which was never the broken one.  
   399  ! REAL FIX: scope every LSEL to the CURRENTLY SELECTED AREA's own lines 
   400  ! via LSLA,S (lines belonging to selected areas) before refining by LOC,
   401  ! so no area's block can ever touch another area's lines -- eliminates the  
   402  ! whole KFORCE cross-contamination class, not just this one instance.   
   403  ! FIX v3 2026-09-15 (job 2490239 post-mortem -- v2 fix above was STILL  
   404  ! wrong, confirmed by a THIRD byte-identical result). Root cause, this  
   405  ! time confirmed directly against the log's own selection-count lines,  
   406  ! not inferred: LSLA,S + LSEL,R correctly scopes the FIRST line of each 
   407  ! pair to the current area (verified: "4 LINES...1 SELECTED AREAS BY LSLA"  
   408  ! then "1 LINE...SELECTED BY LSEL" for the R-type reselect). But the
   409  ! SECOND line of each pair used LSEL,A ("ALSO SELECT") -- and A-type is a   
   410  ! UNION WITH THE FULL DATABASE, not an intersect within whatever LSLA had   
   411  ! scoped -- it is NOT constrained by the preceding LSLA,S at all. So
   412  ! area 1's block (run first) still globally swept every area's RO-edge  
   413  ! line via its own LSEL,A,LOC,X,RO and set them ALL to NDIV_ZH=6 -- 
   414  ! including area 2's and area 3's own outer vertical edges, before either   
   415  ! area had been touched. When area 2/3's own blocks later tried 
   416  ! LESIZE,...,NDIV_ZP=2 on those same (now-already-6) RO lines, KFORCE=0 
   417  ! silently blocked it (confirmed in the log). Net effect unchanged from 
   418  ! v1/v2: both piezo layers still mesh at an effective 40(radial) x  
   419  ! 6(thru, stuck) = 240 elements, AR=45. 
   420  ! REAL FIX: never use LSEL,A (or any global LOC-based select) anywhere in   
   421  ! this block. Every line is now sized by its OWN single-line LSLA,S +   
   422  ! LSEL,R + LESIZE sequence -- four separate calls per area instead of two   
   423  ! combined ones -- so no selection ever reaches outside the lines already   
   424  ! scoped to the current area, and the A-type leak this class of bug 
   425  ! depends on never occurs.
